messages:
Maria G: Quick async check — token-cost instrumentation: where are we on schema v3, owners, and the canary rollout? Need owners + blockers by EOD. cc @Devon L for pipeline, @Jon R for analytics, @Priya K for console.

Jon R: I can take analytics owner. Last PR #5823 is open with schema mapping. I'm blocked on sample payloads from infra.

Devon L: Pipeline owner here. I merged ingestion adapter change this morning (PR #5860). Need the final schema fields list — specifically whether we keep event.session_id.

Maria G: We decided to keep session_id (helps latency attribution). See spec snippet below:
```json
{
  "event_type": "token_emit",
  "model": "redwood-7b",
  "tokens": 120,
  "latency_ms": 250,
  "session_id": "uuid-v4",
  "cost_usd": 0.0034,
  "schema_version": "v3"
}
```

Sam H: From SRE: watch the high-cardinality fields. session_id is fine but we need to hash before logging (PII concern). I'll add a transform in the ingestion path.

Priya K: Console side — need epoch-based buckets for latency chart and a derived "cost per 1k tokens" metric. Ping me when schema v3 is finalized so I can wire dashboards.

Jon R: Analytics plan: we need 2 rollups — per-model and per-route. Also will add sampling flag for low-cost models to reduce volume.

Devon L: Can confirm adapter now supports schema_version and sampling flag. I've added a config toggle: `sampling.rate_by_model = {"redwood-7b":0.1}`

infra-bot: deploy job started: telemetry-ingestion-v2 -> canary-3 on us-west1 (job id t-9981)

Maria G: Canary plan: start with 2% traffic on dedicated, 5% hosted, monitor token error rate and latency delta. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p50 latency increases > 15ms over baseline.

Sam H: I'll set alerts: token_error_rate >0.5%, p50_delta >15ms, storage spike >10%. Will also add a temporary retention increase for debug logs.

Devon L: Blocker: need the final PR sign-off for sample payload anonymizer (PR #5879). @Maria G can you approve?

Maria G: Approved. Quick note: Priya, can you add a short note in the release runbook about dashboard ids and contact points? Savebook: docs/runbooks/token-attrib-canary.md

Priya K: Yep — will add runbook section and post link here when done.

Jon R: ETA on full rollout after successful canary: 48 hours. I'll start the aggregation job once canary hits 12 hours without alerts.

Sam H: LGTM. :thumbsup:

Maria G: Thanks team. If anyone wants a quick sync call I can host 15 min at 3:30pm. Otherwise reply with blockers.

Devon L: No blockers after approval. Will monitor deploy logs.

Priya K: Runbook link posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-attrib-canary.md :eyes: 

Maria G: Closing this thread — will reopen if an incident fires. :pray:
